purpose: Display-only globe context; not used in terrain horizon, illumination, communication, power or battery calculations.
conventions: Equirectangular, centered on 0 degrees longitude. North at top; east-positive longitude. Three sphere axis mapping (X,Y,Z) body-fixed -> (X,Z,-Y).
limitations: Color map is aesthetically processed, with polar fill. JPEG bump relief and constant viewing light are illustrative, not physical terrain displacement or epoch illumination.

assets.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio
assets.purpose: Contextual star background in the active Moon views; not an epoch-aligned sky or an input to planning calculations
